name: PT MNC Digital Entertainment Tbk
summary: PT MNC Digital Entertainment Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, engages in producing, developing, and distributing content and intellectual properties across various media platforms in Indonesia. It operates through Content, IP & Others; Online Advertising; and Subscription segments. The company is involved in media and entertainment activities, such as drama production houses, infotainment, reality shows, game shows, animation, films, original content, micro drama, and music labels.
